verdict.rationale: Testing against an isolated sandbox is a fair question for a cloud ML platform, so the axis applies, but no evidence shows Paperspace offering a sandbox or test mode that is separated from production data. Spinning up separate machines from custom templates or snapshots would be a user-side workaround, not the capability itself. The sandbox and testing claims in the pack belong to separate DigitalOcean products (Managed Agents, Marketplace 1-Click Droplets), not Paperspace, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
